ModuleName: The Module Index: Cataloguing and Viewing Generated Content

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module covering what the Module Index is, how to navigate its interface, and how to open and review generated files, used by instructors to plan or preview the module's learning path.

Artifacts.Name: What Is the Module Index?
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page defining the Module Index, describing its dual roles as a record-keeping system and content viewer for all artifacts a module produces, used by learners to understand why and how the index exists.

Artifacts.Name: Navigating the Module Index Interface
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page describing the layout and features of the Module Index interface — including how to locate, sort, and filter artifacts in one unified hub — used by learners to navigate the index efficiently without relying on local file systems.

Artifacts.Name: Opening and Reviewing Generated Files
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page explaining how to locate, open, and interact with generated artifacts directly from the Module Index, used by learners and instructors to review and validate module output without hunting through external file systems.

Artifacts.Name: The HTML Index as a Self-Contained Browsable Module
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page describing how PreseMaker generates a self-contained HTML index file that serves as a standalone, software-free browsable landing page for all module content, used by learners and instructors to access module artifacts without logging into a platform.

Artifacts.Name: The HTML Index as a Self-Contained Browsable Module
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory text page describing how PreseMaker generates a self-contained HTML index file that serves as a standalone, software-free browsable landing page for all module content, used by learners and instructors to access module artifacts without logging into a platform.
